REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY No. 13 ... / ... / ...）
ial Branch Station. File No. Date October 11, 1941
SUBJECT: Karl Wilhelm LÖWY alias Charles W. LOVY -
Communication dated October 8, 1941 from
Headmaster of Cathedral School, Shanghai.

Karl Wilhelm LÖWY, Austrian Jewish
refugee, born in Vienna on June 25, 1910, arrived
in Shanghai from Europe in May 1939 with his wife
Lily. Since June 1939 he has been working as
translator, proofreader and reporter with Revue
Nationale Chinoise, 2004 Bubbling Well Road. He
is well spoken of by this organization. He is
a teacher of languages by profession and has a
good knowledge of English, French, Italian and
Spanish in addition to his mother tongue. He is
also reported to be a correspondent of a number
of Swiss journals and in addition to using his
own name, also utilizes the pen-name of Klemens
Diez.

Nothing is known by this office
that would in any way reflect to his discredit.
His political inclinations are difficult to
determine but in responsible circles he is
reported to be anti-Nazi in his convictions.

（批：lao.
Mr Li H!

主题：卡尔·威廉·勒维（Karl Wilhelm LÖWY），又名查尔斯·W·洛维（Charles W. LOVY）——
来自上海圣公会学校校长的信函，日期为1941年10月8日。

卡尔·威廉·勒维，奥地利犹太难民，1910年6月25日出生于维也纳，于1939年5月与其妻莉莉（Lily）从欧洲抵达上海。自1939年6月以来，他一直在位于静安寺路2004号的《中国国民评论》（Revue Nationale Chinoise）担任翻译、校对和记者。该机构对他评价良好。他的职业是语言教师，除母语外，还精通英语、法语、意大利语和西班牙语。据报他还是多家瑞士期刊的通讯员，除了使用本名外，还使用笔名克莱门斯·迪茨（Klemens Diez）。

本处未掌握任何可能损害其声誉的信息。他的政治倾向难以确定，但在可靠圈子里，据说他在信念上是反纳粹的。

Special Branch,
S.M.P.

Dear Sirs,

In July last you kindly made enquiries for me in connection with candidates for the post of Science Master here. I wonder if you could be so very kind as to advise me again - this time for a French Master ?

The man I have in view is Charles W. Lovy, 35E Brenan Rd. 2nd Floor. He tells me that he has been in Shanghai 2½ years, & that, though Austrian, he has a German "J" Passport. He writes as follows :-

"I am 31 years old, a graduate of Paris and Vienna universities (Ph.D.), and have passed the written examination for teachers at Austrian secondary schools. I have been teacher at the governmental college and at the Berlitz School of Languages in Le Havre, France, and am at present English and French instructor at a Chinese school. Having done some journalistic work for the past ten years, I am moreover connected with the French language monthly Revue Nationale Chinoise. I shall be glad to show you my testimonials and certificates."

I have interviewed him, and he seems quite suitable ; do you happen to know anything about him ? Of course I will treat as confidential anything you may be able to tell me about him.

With apologies for troubling you,

Yours faithfully,

P. C. Matthews.
（签名：P. C. Matthews）
Headmaster.

致特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

敬启者：

去年七月，承蒙贵处为我查询本校科学教席候选人的情况。不知能否再次劳驾告知——这次是关于一位法语教师的情况？

我属意的人选是查尔斯·W·洛维（Charles W. Lovy），住址为布伦南路35E号二楼。他告诉我，他已在上海待了两年半，虽然是奥地利人，但持有一本德国“J”字护照。他的来信内容如下：-

“我今年31岁，毕业于巴黎和维也纳大学（哲学博士），并通过了奥地利中学教师的笔试。我曾在法国勒阿弗尔的政府学院和伯利兹语言学校任教，目前在一所中文学校担任英语和法语教员。过去十年间我曾从事一些新闻工作，此外还与法文月刊《中国国民评论》有联系。我很乐意向您出示我的推荐信和证书。”

我已面试过他，他似乎相当合适；您是否碰巧了解关于他的任何情况？当然，您能告诉我的关于他的任何信息，我都将保密处理。

为打扰您而致歉，

此致，

P. C. 马修斯。
（签名：P. C. Matthews）
校长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / B. REGISTRY / 927 / 10 7 41）

Special Branch Station. File No. Date July 7, 1941

SUBJECT: Communication dated June 22, 1941 from
Cathedral School, Shanghai - Post of
Science and Mathematics master.

Enquiries made by this office indicate that
of the three persons mentioned in the Reverend
P. C. Matthews' letter, Dr. B. SILBERSTEIN is
best suited to fill the vacant mastership. The
following details have been unearthed regarding this
individual:

Dr. SILBERSTEIN was apparently one of the
wise refugees who left Germany before it became
absolutely imperative. He came to China in 1934
and secured work in a Tientsin hospital which seems
a fairly good indication both of his professional
competence and his general character when it is
realized that he held this post for over three
years. As far as can be ascertained he lost this
position only because there were Chinese who would
undertake the work he was doing and they were
preferred to a European. After coming to Shanghai
in 1937 a post was found for him in the Methodists'
Mission Hospital in Pingliang, Hunan and Dr.
SILBERSTEIN stayed there until it was demolished
by airplane bombing. As far as his service
in Pingliang was concerned, the only adverse reports
received of him concern his ability as a surgeon.
This was more the fault of his training than anything
else. This is due to the defects of the system
of training current in Germany that medical men are
not given adequate opportunities for acquiring

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / B. 登记处 / 927 / 10 7 41）

特别处分站。档案号。日期 1941年7月7日

主题：来自上海圣公会学校的信函，日期为1941年6月22日——科学与数学教席。

本处进行的调查显示，在 P. C. 马修斯牧师信中提到的三人中，B. 西尔伯斯坦（B. SILBERSTEIN）博士最适合填补该空缺教席。关于此人，已挖掘出以下细节：

西尔伯斯坦博士显然是那些在德国局势尚未变得绝对紧迫之前就离开的明智难民之一。他于1934年来到中国，并在天津的一家医院找到了工作，考虑到他担任此职超过三年，这似乎相当好地表明了他的专业能力和一般品格。据查，他失去这一职位仅仅是因为有中国人愿意承担他所做的工作，且他们比欧洲人更受青睐。1937年来到上海后，他在湖南平江的卫理公会传教士医院为他找到了一份工作，西尔伯斯坦博士一直留在那里，直到该医院被飞机轰炸摧毁。就他在平江的服务而言，收到的关于他的唯一不利报告涉及他作为外科医生的能力。这更多是其训练的问题，而非其他原因。这是由于当时德国通行的训练体系的缺陷，即医务人员没有获得足够的机会去获取

REPORT

........................................Station. File No.................... Date....................................
SUBJECT: 2
operating experience. As an internist or as a
member of a large hospital staff Dr. SILBERSTEIN
would probably have been perfectly satisfactory.
Doctors in places such as Pingliang are required
who can do almost anything at a pinch. This
apparently is the reason why he has been unable to
find other hospital employment.
He seems to be an unassuming, modest type of
person likely to co-operate with a group of other
masters in satisfactory style. Besides his
medical qualifications he holds the degree of M.A.
References have been seen which state that he is
well qualified to teach various subjects in
schools of middle-class standard. He seems to
have a good basic knowledge of the subjects required
and is the type of man who would be sufficiently
conscientious to bring himself up-to-date in any
matters where his competence was at present open
to question.
There is no question that he is a Jew by race
but no evidence is available to suggest that he
is anything but profoundly anti-Nazi in his political
beliefs.
He has managed to remain independent in Shanghai
though he has never been in possession of a good
enough income to allow his wife to give up her
position as a school teacher in Tientsin in order
to join him in Shanghai.
Nothing is known by this office that would reflect
adversely to his credit.

主题：2
手术经验。作为一名内科医生或大型医院 staff 的一员，西尔伯斯坦博士可能会完全令人满意。像平江这样的地方需要的医生是那种在紧急情况下几乎什么都能做的人。这显然就是他无法找到其他医院工作的原因。
他似乎是一个谦逊、谦虚的人，可能会以令人满意的方式与其他教师群体合作。除了他的医学资格外，他还拥有文学硕士学位。已看到的推荐信指出，他有资格在中等水平的学校教授各种科目。他似乎对所要求的科目有良好的基础知识，并且是那种足够认真的人，会在其能力目前受到质疑的任何事项上使自己跟上时代。
毫无疑问，他是犹太种族，但没有证据表明他在政治信仰上不是深刻的反纳粹分子。
他在上海设法保持了独立，尽管他的收入从未足够好到能让他的妻子放弃在天津的学校教师职位来上海与他团聚。
本处未掌握任何可能对其声誉产生不利影响的信息。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Station. File No. Date

SUBJECT: §

Dr. Kurt GRAFTMANN is not a fully fledged doctor but a "doctor's assistant." Though he appears an able and well-qualified man from a teaching point of view, the fact remains that according to his own statement he has been an inmate of Dachau Concentration Camp, release from which can only be secured under certain circumstances which nearly always include the signing of a document or documents stating that the prisoner concerned will do nothing to hinder the progress of the Nazi machine but on the contrary suitably assist it in its march forward. While there are instances of political prisoners released from concentration camps doing their utmost to work against Nazism, the experience of this office has been such as distrust anybody who has been in any concentration camp in Nazi occupied territory.

Nothing is known by this office that would reflect to Dr. GRAFTMANN'S discredit.

In regard to Dr. DRUCKER this person is well spoken of in refugee circles. He is said to be an excellent tutor and teacher but it would seem that his talents are better suited to the teaching of students far more advanced than the curriculum at the Cathedral School at present allows. Nothing can be secured locally about his modus vivendi in Europe although it has to be mentioned that nothing is known to his discredit in Shanghai.

（批：10 7 发）

A.C. (Special Branch).

（签名）
D.S.I.

报告

分站。档案号。日期

主题：§

库尔特·格拉夫曼（Kurt GRAFTMANN）博士不是一名正式医生，而是一名“医生助理”。虽然从教学角度来看，他似乎是一位能干且资历良好的人，但事实是，根据他自己的陈述，他曾是达豪集中营的囚犯，而从那里获释只能在某些情况下实现，这些情况几乎总是包括签署一份或多份文件，声明有关囚犯不会做任何阻碍纳粹机器进步的事情，相反会适当地协助其向前推进。虽然有政治犯从集中营释放后尽力反对纳粹主义的实例，但本处的经验使得我们怀疑任何曾在纳粹占领区集中营待过的人。

本处未掌握任何可能损害格拉夫曼博士声誉的信息。

关于德鲁克（DRUCKER）博士，此人在难民圈中口碑良好。据说他是一位优秀的辅导老师和教师，但他的才能似乎更适合教导比目前圣公会学校课程所允许的水平高得多的学生。虽然必须提到在上海未掌握任何对他不利的信息，但在当地无法获取关于他在欧洲的生活方式（modus vivendi）的任何信息。

（批：10 7 发）

HENRY LESTER ENDOWMENT
39 MYBURGH ROAD,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
22nd June BRITISH REGISTRY
No. N. 927
21 / 6 / 111

Major K.M.Bourne, C.B.E., M.C.

Dear Major Bourne,
I have been advertising for a Science & Maths. Master for September, and, as I expected, I find that (apart from one Chinese) only refugees applied. From the various applications I have received, three appear to be the most suitable:-

(1) B.Silberstein, M.D., 153-C Rte des Soeurs, Apt.15. Aged 52, born at Dt.Eylau "in the former corridor between Germany and Poland" - but his family have many connections with England & have in several occasions/ instances married Englishmen. He was at the Universities of Berlin, Paris, Bonne & Cologne, and came out to China in 1934 ; he has been at Pingkiang, Hunan, at the English Methodist's Mission's Hospital, until it was bombed by the Japanese. He gives as local references Rev. C.L.Boynton & Dr. Hodgins, 169 Yuen Ming Yuen Rd. Though more of a doctor than a teacher, I rather favour him - he speaks very good English, and appears a really cultured man.

(2) Dr. Kurt Graftmann, 165-167 Chaoufoong Rd, 3rd Floor. Aged 29, married. Free Austrian, Czech mother & Austrian father. Vienna University; "im-prisoned , after Austria'a invasion by Herr Hitler, because of my demo-cratic attitude, and I was sent to the well-known concentration camp, Dochau. I suffered, for nearly 1½ years, from this "cultural" institution and I was released because I signed to leave Austria for ever." Has been 2 years here ; registered at the S.M.C.Educ. Dept (FA-6/40) ; recommended by Mr. A.T.Cox (who speaks well of him), Mr P.B.Joly, C.M.C. & Mr. Greiner, Navy Y.M.C.A. A very likely choice, too.

(3) Dr. Drucker, 609 E.Seward Rd, house 16 ; aged about 50, at present has a part-time post at St. John's, where he teaches post-graduate classes; German Jew, I think - but I would only choose him if both the others proved unsuitable - especially as he much wants to keep on at St. John's, where he has been some time.

I should be very grateful indeed if you could give me any information or advice about these men ; their references, after all, can only speak from superficial knowledge, naturally.

With apologies for troubling you,

Yours sincerely,

AC(spA-)
P. C. Matthews.
(印：SHANGHAI P.O. CENSORED 29 JUNE 1941)

6月22日 英国登记处
第 N. 927 号
21 / 6 / 111 [注：原文年份疑似OCR错误，应为41]

K.M. 伯恩少校，C.B.E., M.C.

亲爱的伯恩少校，

我一直在为九月份招聘一名科学与数学教师，正如我所料，我发现（除了一名中国人外）只有难民申请。从我收到的各种申请中，有三个人似乎最合适：-

(1) B. 西尔伯斯坦（B. Silberstein），医学博士，地址：姐妹路153-C号，15室。52岁，出生于“前德国与波兰之间的走廊”中的 Dt. Eylau [注：即 Deutsch Eylau，今波兰伊瓦瓦]——但他的家族与英国有许多联系，并且在多个场合/实例中与英国人通婚。他就读于柏林、巴黎、波恩和科隆大学，并于1934年来到中国；他一直在湖南平江的英国卫理公会传教士医院工作，直到该医院被日本人轰炸。他提供的本地推荐人是 C.L. Boynton 牧师和 Hodgins 博士，地址：圆明园路169号。虽然他更像医生而不是教师，但我比较看好他——他的英语说得很好，看起来是一个真正有教养的人。

(2) 库尔特·格拉夫曼（Kurt Graftmann）博士，地址：曹丰路165-167号，三楼。29岁，已婚。自由奥地利人，母亲是捷克人，父亲是奥地利人。维也纳大学；“在希特勒先生入侵奥地利后，因我的民主态度而被‘监禁’，并被送往著名的达豪集中营。我在这所‘文化’机构遭受了近1年半的痛苦，因为我签署了永远离开奥地利的文件而获释。”已在此地2年；在上海公共租界工部局教育处注册（FA-6/40）；由 A.T. Cox 先生（对他评价良好）、P.B. Joly 先生（中华基督教青年会全国协会）、以及海军基督教青年会的 Greiner 先生推荐。也是一个很有希望的人选。

(3) 德鲁克（Drucker）博士，地址：西华德路东段609号，16号房屋；约50岁，目前在圣约翰大学有一份兼职工作，在那里他教授研究生课程；我想他是德国犹太人——但只有在前两人都不合适的情况下我才会选择他——特别是因为他非常想继续在圣约翰大学工作，他在那里已经有一段时间了。

如果您能给我提供关于这些人的任何信息或建议，我将不胜感激；毕竟，他们的推荐人自然只能基于肤浅的了解发言。

为打扰您而致歉，

此致，

AC(spA-)
P. C. 马修斯。

Enquiries made by this office indicate that 
of the three persons mentioned in the Reverend 
P. C. Matthews’ letter, Dr. B. SILBERSTEIN is 
best suited to fill the vacant mastership. The 
following details have been unearthed regarding this 
individuals 

Dre SILBERSTEIN was apparently one of the 
wise refugees who left Germany before it became 
absolutely imperative. He came to China in 1934 
and secured work in a Tientsin hospital which seems 
a fairly good indication both of his professional 
competence and his general character when it is 
realized that he held this post for over three 
years. As far as can be ascertained he lost this 
position only because there were Chinese who would 
undertake the work he was doing and they were 
preferred to a European. After coming to Shanghai 
in 1937 a post was found for him in the Methodists? 
Mission Hospital in Pingliang, Human and Dr. - 
SILBERSTEIN stayed there until it was demolished 
by airplane bombing. As far as his — service 
in Pingliang was concerned, the only adverse reports 
received of him coneern his ability as @ surgeone 
This was more the fault eof his training than anything 
else. This is due to the defects of the system 
of training current in Germany that medical ‘ine. are 


not given adequate opportunities for acquiring

Dre Kurt GRAFTMANN is not a fully fledged doctor 
but a "doctor's assistant." Though he appears an 
able and well-qualified man from a teaching point 
of view, the fact remains that according to his 
own statement he has been an inmate of Dachau 
Concentration Camp, release from which can only be 
secured under certain circumstances which nearly 
always include the signing of a document or documents 
stating that the prisoner concerned will do nothing 
to hinder the progress of the Nazi machine but on 
the contrary suitably assist it in its march forwarde 
While there are instances of political prisoners 
released from concentration camps doing their utmost 
to work against Nazism, the experience of this office 
has been such as distrust anybody who has been in any 


concentration camp in Nazi occupied territory.
